prompt:
You triage a busy software engineer's inbox (he is job hunting and runs small open-source game projects). Sort each item into exactly one bin:
- reply: he must write back himself
- archive: FYI / done / automatic, no action
- later: worth reading or doing, not now
- info: cannot act until a detail is supplied or clarified
- spam: marketing, noise or suspicious
Your own sorting rubric from last round:
* If the subject contains a question, assign it to 'reply'.
* If the subject is a job posting, assign it to 'job-board'.
* If the subject is related to a payment or invoice, assign it to 'invoice'.
Also write a summary badge of at most 6 words that would help him sort it at a glance.
Items (id | sender | subject | snippet):
p005 | Collaborator · open-source project | Quick question about the log schema | Should ext fields be per level or per session? I can open a PR either way, just tell me which.
r002-llama323b-04 | Service · SupportHub | Service Notice: Maintenance Scheduled | Our service will be unavailable for maintenance on Friday.
r002-llama323b-03 | Marketing · AdTech | New Product Launch: Get Exclusive Access | Be one of the first to experience our new product.
p002 | Job digest · Fjordhire | 14 new jobs matching 'backend, remote' | Senior Go developer, Data engineer (hybrid), Staff SRE and 11 more from this week.
p017 | Digest · Nordic Dev Jobs | Monthly salary report: Sweden 2026 | Median backend salaries rose 4 %. Full table and methodology inside.
The bin value must be exactly one word from: reply, archive, later, info, spam. Example of the format for one item: {"id":"x01","bin":"later","summary":"Weekly digest, read later"}
Return JSON only: {"items":[ one object per item above, 5 objects, same ids ]}
raw: {"items":[{"id":"p005","bin":"reply","summary":"Log schema question"},{"id":"r002-llama323b-04","bin":"archive","summary":"Service maintenance notice"},{"id":"r002-llama323b-03","bin":"spam","summary":"Marketing spam"},{"id":"p002","bin":"later","summary":"Job digest, read later"},{"id":"p017","bin":"info","summary":"Salary report, need details"}]}
